start: Member: Settings, Export and import, 40 workouts logged, phone in kg

steps.action: Tap 'Save my history'
user_sees: The button reads 'Saving…' while the file is made
Android's share sheet titled 'Save my history' with a .csv file named mettleup-history-<today>.csv
must_not: The button can be tapped again while 'Saving…' shows
Half a file is offered when a page of workouts fails to read

steps.action: Pick Files or Drive in the share sheet
user_sees: A short buzz, the button back to 'Save my history'
The note 'Every workout and set in one file (Hevy’s format)…' stays under it
must_not: An error line after a good share
Weights in pounds while the phone is set to kg

start: Member: Settings, Export and import, body weight logged on 20 days

steps.action: Tap 'Save my measurements'
user_sees: 'Saving…' on the button
The share sheet with one file, one row per day of body weight, body fat and measurements
must_not: Two rows for the same day
The sample member's figures in the file

steps.action: Close the share sheet
user_sees: The button back to 'Save my measurements'
must_not: A red error after the member simply closed the sheet

start: Member: Settings, Export and import, a new install with no workout and no body weight

steps.action: Tap 'Save my history'
user_sees: The grey line 'Nothing to save yet — log a workout first.'
must_not: An empty .csv offered in the share sheet
A red error for an empty history

steps.action: Tap 'Save my measurements'
user_sees: The grey line 'Nothing to save yet — log your body weight or a measurement first.'
must_not: A file with only the header row

steps.action: On a phone with no share target, log a workout and tap 'Save my history'
user_sees: The red line 'Sharing isn’t available on this phone, so the file couldn’t be handed over.'
must_not: The button stuck on 'Saving…'

start: Member: Settings, Export and import, demo data loaded, then removed

steps.action: With the sample member loaded, tap 'Save my measurements'
user_sees: 'This is the sample member’s data, so nothing was saved. Remove the sample data and log your own first.'
must_not: A file of the made-up measurements

steps.action: Remove demo data, log one body weight, come back and tap 'Save my measurements'
user_sees: The share sheet with a file of one row
must_not: The old 'sample member' line still shown
Demo rows mixed into the new file

start: Member: Settings, Export and import, own workouts and measurements logged

steps.action: Tap 'Save my history', then 'Save my measurements', and send both to own email
user_sees: Two files only the member chose where to send
must_not: Any file sent to the gym or to MettleUp without the member choosing it
A paywall or Plus lock on either button
Old export files from an earlier day left in the share list
